name: SEMI GEM300 standards suite
description: The set of SEMI equipment-communication standards (E39, E40, E87, E90, E94, E116, E148, E157 on top of SECS-II/HSMS/GEM, as defined in SEMI E192) that 300 mm fabs require for fully automated carrier, job and wafer handling.

name: SEMI E40/E94 process and control job management
description: SEMI E40 (process jobs: which recipe to run on which wafers) and SEMI E94 (control jobs: a unit of work for one or more carriers made of process jobs), used together for host-directed processing.

name: SEMI E87 carrier management (CMS)
description: SEMI standard for host-equipment communication during carrier transfers at load ports, including carrier ID and slot-map verification.

name: SEMI E90 substrate tracking
description: SEMI standard under which equipment tracks each substrate (wafer) inside the tool for the factory system.

name: SEMI E116 equipment performance tracking (EPT)
description: SEMI standard for automatic reporting of equipment and module states, time in state and blocked reasons to the host.

name: SEMI E10 equipment RAM and utilization
description: SEMI standard (first published 1986) defining six basic equipment states and reliability, availability, maintainability and utilization metrics (MTBF, MTTR, uptime).

name: SEMI E84 carrier handoff parallel I/O
description: SEMI standard for the hardware signals used when AMHS vehicles hand a carrier to or from a tool load port or stocker.

name: SEMI Equipment Data Acquisition (Interface A)
description: SEMI web-services standards suite (E120, E125, E128, E132, E134, E138, E164) for high-volume equipment data collection by multiple factory clients, alongside SECS/GEM.

name: SEMI E183 Rich Interactive Test Database (RITdb)
description: SEMI test-data standard (first published 2021) combining a relational data container able to hold all STDF content with real-time MQTT publish-subscribe streaming for test floors.

name: AEC-Q001 part average testing guideline
description: Automotive Electronics Council guideline for removing statistical outlier parts using static or dynamic test limits.

name: Automotive Electronics Council (AEC)
description: Body that publishes the AEC-Q qualification and screening documents used by automotive chip buyers, including AEC-Q001 on part average testing.

name: SEMI E187 cybersecurity of fab equipment
description: SEMI baseline security requirements for Windows/Linux computers in fab equipment and AMHS (OS support, network security, endpoint protection, monitoring), published 2022.

name: Automated material handling system (AMHS)
description: The ceiling-mounted vehicles (OHT), stockers, buffers and lifts, plus control software, that move wafer carriers (FOUPs) between tools in a fab without people carrying them.

name: Material control system (MCS)
description: Fab software that schedules and controls carrier movements by the AMHS on instruction from the MES/dispatcher.

name: Advanced process control (APC) / run-to-run system
description: Software that adjusts recipe parameters run by run from metrology and sensor data to keep process results on target.

name: Statistical process control (SPC) system
description: Software that charts measurements against control limits and flags out-of-control conditions that stop tools and trigger action plans.

name: Yield management system (YMS)
description: Software that combines inline, parametric, defect, test and genealogy data to find causes of yield loss (e.g. PDF Exensio, KLA Klarity, Onto Discover, Synopsys Yield Explorer).

name: secureWISE remote equipment access network
description: Private network and software (owned by PDF Solutions since March 2025) through which equipment suppliers remotely monitor and, if the fab permits, control tools in customer fabs.

name: Samsung SDS Nexplant MES
description: MES suite from Samsung SDS covering scheduling and dispatching, manufacturing operations, material control and SECS-based tool control.

name: Frost & Sullivan
description: Consulting and market-research firm founded in 1961; prepared the issuer-commissioned China IMSS market report used in the Glorysoft HKEX prospectus.

name: Semiconductor Assembly Test Automation and Standardization Research Association (SATAS)
description: Japanese research association (founded by 15 organisations incl. Intel and Daifuku; 38 members by April 2026) developing standardised, automated back-end assembly and test lines by 2028.
